# E0712: a value in a schema accepts any value, which has no Cap'n Proto type

_ accepts any value, and Cap'n Proto has no type for any value: every field,
list element and union member has one. This includes _ as a list element, a
map value or one alternative of a disjunction.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				cargo: _
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0712]: cargo in schema 0.0 accepts any value, which has no Cap'n Proto type
 --> lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 cargo: _
  |                 ^^^^^
  |
  = note: cargo in schema 0.0 is _, which has no type (Cap'n Proto rule top)
  = help: declare the type
```
